title: Check if Word Can Be Placed In Crossword
goal: Check whether a word fits exactly in a horizontal or vertical crossword slot.
strategy: A valid slot is bounded by the board edge or blocked cells and has exactly the word length. Check both reading directions, allowing blanks and requiring existing letters to match.
